_comment: defaultnowarn - default, with the warning face blanked out.
This file is NOT the same as default.recipe.json, which carries an identical
empty ops list for a different reason. Do not read one as describing the
other.
An empty ops list means: copy the baseline icons verbatim, do not decode and
re-encode. Rebuilding this theme therefore produces the STOCK icon set, not
the committed one. The committed set differs in exactly one file:
Icons/WarnFace.tiff    64x64 RGBA, every decoded byte zero
so the warning-face glyph does not render. The other 96 icons match the
baseline byte for byte. That blanking was done by hand, and it is the whole
point of the theme.
The consequence, which is why `build --check` refuses and names
WarnFace.tiff: a recipe can describe a recolour or a blur, but it cannot
express "this pixel is zero". No ops list can reproduce a hand-placed file,
so a build here is a reset to stock, not a regeneration. `--force` will do
it if asked. It should not be asked.
Do not add ops to make the set reproducible. Tinting the icons would change
all 97 of them to fix one, and this theme is deliberately stock-looking.
tdtheme apply default         # stock icons, warning face shown
tdtheme apply defaultnowarn   # stock icons, warning face hidden
See themes/defaultnowarn/TouchColors.yaml for the full description.
